children.name: Narcine timlei
children.description: Narcine timlei, the blackspotted numbfish, black-spotted electric ray, Indian electric ray, largespotted numbfish or spotted numbfish, is a species of numbfish in the family Narcinidae.

children.name: Narcine brasiliensis
children.description: Narcine brasiliensis, the Brazilian electric ray or lesser numbfish, is a species of electric ray in the family Narcinidae.

children.name: Narcine brunnea
children.description: Narcine brunnea, the brown numbfish or brown electric ray, is a species of numbfish in the family Narcinidae.

children.name: Narcine entemedor
children.description: Narcine entemedor, the giant electric ray or Cortez electric ray, is a species of numbfish, family Narcinidae, native to the eastern Pacific Ocean from the Gulf of California to Panama.

children.name: Benthobatis yangi
children.description: Benthobatis yangi, the Taiwanese blind electric ray, is a species of fish in the family Narcinidae endemic to marine ecosystems near Taiwan.

children.name: Benthobatis marcida
children.description: thumb | right Benthobatis marcida, the blind torpedo, is a species of electric ray most commonly found in the west–central area of the Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Benthobatis moresbyi
children.description: Benthobatis moresbyi, commonly known as the dark blindray, dark blind ray, or the Indian blind numbfish, is an electric ray species in the family Narcinidae.
